title: Carbon and Its Compounds
summary: Grade 10: covalent bonding and allotropes of carbon, hydrocarbons and homologous series, functional groups, ethanol and ethanoic acid, and soaps and detergents.

ib.statementOfInquiry: Carbon's ability to form chains and rings creates millions of compounds, from fuels and plastics to medicines and the molecules of life.

conceptual: Why can carbon form so many compounds?
How does a functional group change a molecule's properties?
debatable: Should ethanol blending in petrol be increased, given its effect on food crops?
